best_title: Muthappa Rai: From Bank Clerk to Underworld Don
description:
Discover the stranger-than-fiction life of Muthappa Rai, one of India's most complex underworld figures. From his humble beginnings as a Syndicate Bank clerk to his reign over the Bengaluru and Mumbai crime syndicates, and his eventual transition into a philanthropist, this documentary explores the untold chapters of his life.

► How a Syndicate Bank clerk entered the dark world of crime
► High-profile underworld activities in Bengaluru and Mumbai during the 80s and 90s
► The dramatic 2002 court premises assassination attempt he miraculously survived
► His transformation into a social activist and founder of the REACH NGO
► His final years and passing away due to brain cancer in May 2020
